definition: The nibbāna element without remainder, governed as part of the nibbāna-dhātu family.
notes: Keep this compound tied to the nibbāna element family and avoid materialist or annihilationist overreading.

example_phrases.notes: Shows the standard consummation-side designation within the twofold nibbāna-element framework.

example_phrases.pali: Tassa idheva, bhikkhave, sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sīti bhavissanti.
example_phrases.translation: For them, bhikkhus, right here, everything felt — being not relished — will become cool.
example_phrases.notes: The whole definition of this element. Note the future tense and `idheva`, both preserved. Verified by hand against the cached root text at iti44:4.3.
